data.name: Alpha
data.description:
Alpha is driven by revenge against the Cult of Diablos, for the suffering she endured when she was a child. Hence why she is determined to make Shadow Garden prosper, in order to fulfill that goal and looks down on those who get in the way of her and her comrades.However, Alpha is more than that, being compassionate and loyal to Cid and her comrades in Shadow Garden. Alpha has the utmost faith in her master as she knows his full strength, but there are times she is concerned for his safety and well-being and pleads for him to trust her and Shadow Garden. Her faith is so strong, she's even willing to give her life to him and nearly did so when it looked like Shadow abandoned her and Shadow Garden.Alpha is the second-strongest member of Shadow Garden, surpassed only by Shadow. Her strength is so unchallenged that none within the organization dare oppose her, including her fellow "Shadows", and even Cid was impressed by how much she had grown. Rose and Alexia noted that while Shadow is the ultimate threshold of strength, Alpha is at least at the level of his footing. However, while proficient in many areas, she is outmatched by her comrades in the fields they specialize Supernatural Physical Prowess
It is speculated that one of the reasons Alpha become very powerful is internally at her magical level at her internal body due to the failed initial experiments that Shadow made to her, while he trying to dissipate and contain its lack of control of magical power that Alpha had in her body from the Demon Possession after managed to return at her true form.

Professional Swordsmanship
Alpha has shown to be a powerful swordswoman, easily disarming Iris Midgar, albeit by catching her off-guard, and defeating a monstrously mutated Millia which Iris struggled against. Alpha is also the only other person aside from the Shadow who has been known to have defeated Delta, whose destructive power is second only to the former. Even her master was impressed by how much she had grown in power and skill.Aside from her combat abilities, she also possesses excellent stealth and infiltration skills, educated by Cid himself as he honed such abilities in his past and new lives. Alpha is very good at hiding her presence well from anyone, except for her Lord Shadow, who can detect her easily having known her for years Leadership
Alpha is a competent commander, serving as Shadow Garden's second-in-command and effectively its true leader since she is the one who manages the organization and saw to its growth to a global network of agents. Meanwhile, although Shadow is the official leader, he often has no idea what is going on, which Alpha is ignorant of given his role in her origin.Despite her rarely displaying the use of magic, Alpha is known to be extremely gifted in the practice, being able to heal those under the possession without any difficulty, something only Cid and Epsilon are capable of.Alpha can charge her magic into her slime sword and launch it in the form of a powerful dive attack against her enemy. When she fights the mutation of the Millia, Viscount Grease's daughter, Alpha uses this ability for the first time.[5]Given her mastery of magic and discipline of character, Alpha is always looking to improve her technique, thus she has been able to master the Vampire Queen's technique in record time after studying its source. Now, Alpha can master this technique and her body can become a kind of magical mist pool like the Red Mist, with which she can deal a lot of damage, pierce through physical attacks, and better magic if she is somewhat small or partially invincible. She used this ability during the Trade Conflict against a counterfeiting master, revealed to be Shadow. She acted frantically from feeling betrayed, but Shadow defeated her as she couldn't resume the use of Red Mist when he was likely to irreparably spread her along the winds.[6]Flash
Alpha can use her magic to move quickly against her enemies very quickly, this ability was taught to her by her master, Shadow, just like the other original members of Shadow Garden.
